'''Borlo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] who lived in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Zarra/Legends|Zarra]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]], during the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Borlo was an informant for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], which he provided with information about anything unusual that took place in Zarra.
